checkout_method: Public remote clone in a neutral build path, clean before fetch and build; no local object alternates.

build_steps.command: UnrealEditor-Cmd <fresh-root>/ProjectONE.uproject -unattended -nop4 -nosplash -nullrhi -ExecCmds="Automation RunTests ProjectONE" -TestExit="Automation Test Queue Empty" -ReportOutputPath=<local-report-dir>

upstream_engine_diagnostic.classification: Unchanged Unreal Engine diagnostic example shown only when LOCALAPPDATA is missing while clearing the driver PSO cache. It is not a path from this project or validation host and is not used for filesystem access.

audit_correction: An initial whole-binary UTF8 errors-ignore scan fabricated three path-like strings across PCM/compressed bytes. The corrected scan preserves invalid-byte boundaries and checks printable path components; all eight asset hashes and relative import fields remained unchanged. Original findings and byte-offset review are retained privately.
limits: Fresh Editor/Game/package and source automation are separate from packaged play, native input, media and performance.
No game binary is modified after build. Debug symbols, logs and captured Saved output are omitted from the archive.
